notes: Combined from two official portal queries per report type: seasons 2013/2014–2019/2020 and 2020/2021–2025/2026.
Current boundary mode was selected in both queries. Do not assume the series reflects a geometrically identical area in every year; the portal's reported registered area can vary.
Raw rendered-table captures retain grouped headers and summary row. Normalized CSVs have explicit field names and exclude table headers/summaries.
Decimal commas and portal's original source flags are preserved.
Sample sizes are included and should be assessed before comparing average age or carcass weights.
